name: headroom

description: Compression savings, prefix-cache discount, quota and health metrics from your Headroom proxy
author: nmindz

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Headroom URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Headroom proxy, without a trailing path. For a Docker container, use the host port you published (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:41090).

preferences.name: proxyToken
preferences.title: Proxy Token
preferences.description: Only needed when Headroom runs with HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN (or --proxy-token). Sent as the X-Headroom-Proxy-Token header.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty when Headroom has no token

preferences.name: timezone
preferences.title: Time Zone
preferences.description: IANA time zone used for "today", weeks and months (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo). Leave empty to use the system time zone.

preferences.name: quotaDisplay
preferences.title: Quota Display
preferences.description: Show subscription quota as consumed or remaining percentage.

tools.name: get-savings-summary
tools.title: Get Savings Summary
tools.description: Get Headroom's compression savings (tokens and USD), provider prefix-cache discount, input cost and cost without Headroom for a time window, the current display session or lifetime, with a daily series, the top models and the change versus the previous equal-length window. Window: a `period` preset, `session`, `lifetime`, or explicit `startDate`/`endDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, in the configured time zone; explicit dates override the preset). Weeks start on Monday. Defaults to the last 7 days.

tools.name: get-model-savings
tools.title: Get Model Savings
tools.description: Rank models by compression savings, prefix-cache discount, input cost or tokens saved for a time window or lifetime. Use this to answer which model saved or cost the most. Window: a `period` preset, `lifetime`, or explicit `startDate`/`endDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, in the configured time zone; explicit dates override the preset). Weeks start on Monday. Defaults to the last 7 days.

tools.name: get-prefix-cache-stats
tools.title: Get Prefix Cache Stats
tools.description: Get provider prefix-cache statistics observed by Headroom: hit rate, cache read and write tokens, write premium, net discount in USD, cache busts and their cost in tokens, miss reasons and 5-minute versus 1-hour TTL mix, since the proxy started and lifetime, plus the cache discount for a time window.

tools.name: get-compression-stats
tools.title: Get Compression Stats
tools.description: Get how Headroom compresses requests since the proxy started: compressed requests, average and best compression, tokens saved per strategy, router decisions, waste signals found in prompts, compression versus cache-bust trade-off, CCR retrievals and TOIN pattern stats.

tools.name: get-agent-usage
tools.title: Get Agent Usage
tools.description: Get tokens before and after compression, tokens saved, savings percent, models and share of requests per client agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) since the proxy started.

tools.name: get-subscription-quota
tools.title: Get Subscription Quota
tools.description: Get the Anthropic subscription windows Headroom tracks (5-hour, 7-day and per-model 7-day utilization, reset times, extra usage) with Headroom's contribution in the current window, plus OpenAI Codex rate limits and GitHub Copilot quotas when available.

tools.name: get-proxy-health
tools.title: Get Proxy Health
tools.description: Get Headroom's readiness and liveness: version, uptime, per-component checks (upstream, cache, compression model, memory), deployment, request latency, overhead and time to first byte, error counts and persistence state.

tools.name: get-recent-requests
tools.title: Get Recent Requests
tools.description: List the most recent requests Headroom proxied (newest first) with model, provider, tokens before and after optimization, tokens saved, transforms applied and latency. Only available when Headroom exposes per-request metadata to this client.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1

ai.instructions:
"Saved by Headroom" means compressionSavingsUsd: input tokens Headroom's compression removed before forwarding, priced at the model's input rate. providerCacheDiscountUsd is the provider's prefix-cache discount that Headroom observes (Headroom only keeps prefixes stable to raise hit rates); report it separately and never present it as Headroom's own savings. combinedSavingsUsd adds both plus output-shaping savings; say so when you use it.
Costs are USD estimates from Headroom's price table, not an invoice. costWithoutHeadroomUsd is the input cost plus compression savings.
Windowed figures come from Headroom's savings history, which keeps a bounded number of checkpoints (5,000 by default). When a tool returns a warning about partial data, repeat it. In windows, requests counts only requests that saved something.
"session" is Headroom's display session, which rolls over after an hour without requests. "Since proxy start" counters reset when Headroom restarts. Lifetime figures are persisted.
Always state the date range and time zone (the window object) that the figures cover. Weeks start on Monday. When the user names a relative period, pass the matching period preset instead of computing dates; use startDate and endDate only for explicit dates.
Token hit rate weights by tokens; request hit rate counts requests with any cache read. If subscription tracking has no data, explain the reason the tool returns. If recent requests are unavailable, explain that Headroom must trust this client first.
